tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bla sgrub rtsa ba tshig bdun pa'i: dbang bskur pad+ma'i myu gu bzhugs: :

rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: bla ma'i dus thabs bstan pa yi: ye shes rim pas rgyud smin pa: dbang bskur kun gyi rgyal po ste: snod bcud rten 'brel 'dzom pa'i tshe: byin chags gnas su tshes bcu'i dus: maṇ+ḍal me tog tshom bus brgyan: bum pa gtor ma phyag rgya sku: sngags phreng rang byung shel rdo bkod: phyi nang mchod tshogs ci 'byor spungs: dbang rab dran rdzogs ting 'dzin gsal: spyan 'dren bzlas pa tsam gyis 'grub: blo dman phrin las gzhung bsrangs la: bla ma sku gsum sku bzhi sogs: gang dgos bskyed bzlas kha bsgyur dang: bdag mdun sgrub tshul spyi ltar spyad: gang yang ga ṇa tsakra yis: thugs dam skong zhing byin rlabs 'bebs: slob ma khrus bya yon phul la: dad pas thal sbyar gsol gsum gdab: rigs kun bdag po khyod la 'dud: ye shes snying po'i dkyil 'khor du: gzhug cing sgo gsum smin bya'i phyir: bla ma che ge'i dbang bskur stsol: gnang ba sbyin cing dam tshig bsgrag: 'dir zhugs bu khyod legs par 'ongs: rdo rje'i dam tshig bsrung nus na: dgongs pas rjes bzung bka' bzhin sgrubs: tshe gcig bla med sa 'thob 'gyur: zhes bsgos lan du 'di skad gsol: ma hā gu ru bdag la dgongs: bka' las mi 'da' dam tshig bsrung: thugs rjes rtag tu bzung ba dang: rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed du gsol: rdo rje mgor bzhag dam chu sbyin: ji snyed dam tshig gsang ba che: bla ma'i sku gsung thugs su 'dus: de nyid mi 'bral srog bzhin du: mos gus brtan pos bsgrub par gyis: badz+ra sa ma ya hūm̐: 'jug sgo skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang: tshogs gsag dbye bsdu rgyud tshod bstun: ye shes byin chen 'beb pa ni: slob dpon dgongs pa'i rtsal bskyed cing: slob ma sgo gsum mi g.yo bar: rtog tshogs 'od gsal dbyings su sbyangs: skad cig ye shes mkha' 'gro ma: dmar gsal gcer bu rus rgyan can:

gri thod 'dzin cing gar sgyur ba'i: snying nang g.yung drung lte bar hrī: yan lag ha ri ni sas mtshan: bdag thugs 'od zer gyis bskul bas: g.yon skor drag tu 'khor ba yi: 'od zer nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams dang: pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang nas: bla ma dkon mchog rtsa ba gsum: gu ru che ge'i rnam pa ru: nyi zer rdul 'khrigs lta bur byon: dbyer med thim nas byin brlabs bsam: tshig bdun sham bu bcas pas bskul: cang te'u dril bu gdung dbyangs sbyar: me tog mgor bzhag rab tu gnas: ye shes bstims pas mkha' 'gro'i sku: gnas 'gyur gu ru che ger gsal: bla ma'i thugs las 'od 'phros pas: nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha: spyan drangs bum pa'i bdud rtsi yis: rdo rje'i gtor blugs sbyin par bsam: hrī: ji ltar nus ldan rdo rje yis: byang chub sras rnams dbang bskur ltar: byin rlabs chu bos rtog sgrib bkru: dbang bzhi'i ye shes rtsal rdzogs shog: so so'i sngags mthar dbang sngags sbyar: oṃ badz+rī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: bum pa'i bdud rtsi 'thor 'thung bya: bum chus lus gang rtog sgrib dag: phung khams dag pa'i 'khor lor smin: chu lhag yar lud spyi bo ru: rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab rdzogs: khyad par byin rlabs sbyin pa ni: sku dang oṃ yig 'od zer dkar: gu ru'i dpral ba'i gnas nas 'phros: bu yi dpral bar thim bsams la: mtshon byed sku brnyan spyi bor bzhag: oṃ: gu ru che ge yi: ye shes phyag rgya sku yi dbang: spyi bor thim pas lus sgrib dag: snang stong sprul sku 'grub par shog: kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: sngags phreng āḥyig 'od zer dmar: gu ru'i mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'phros: bu yi mgrin par thim bsams la: mtshon byed sngags phreng mgrin par bzhag: ā: gu ru che ge yi: gsang sngags yig 'bru gsung gi dbang: mgrin par thim pas ngag sgrib dag:

grags stong longs skur 'grub par shog: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: phyag mtshan hūm̐ yig 'od zer mthing: gu ru'i thugs ka'i gnas nas 'phros: bu yi snying gar thim bsams la: mtshon byed shel rdo snying gar bzhag: hūm̐: gu ru che ge yi: rig rtsal rol pa thugs kyi dbang: snying gar thim pas yid sgrib dag: rig stong chos sku 'grub par shog: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: byin rlabs hrīḥyig 'od sna tshogs: gu ru'i gnas bzhi dag nas 'phros: bu yi gnas bzhir thim bsams la: gtor ma lhar gsal gnas bzhir bzhag: hrī: gu ru che ge yi: byin rlabs yongs rdzogs gtor ma'i dbang: gnas bzhir bskur bas sgrib bzhi dag: sku bzhi lhun gyis grub par shog: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: gtor ma kho na la brten nas: spros med snying po'i byin rlabs ni: gsol gdab rgyud sbyong ye shes dbab: gtor snod ye shes gzhal yas su: gtor ma gu ru so sor gsal: gnas bzhi nas spros yig 'bru bzhi: 'od zer dkar dmar mthing ser rnams: slob ma'i gnas bzhir thim pa yis: dbang bzhi thob cing sgrib bzhi sbyangs: sku bzhi mngon du 'gyur bsams la: gtor chen btegs mthar gnas bzhir bzhag: hūm̐ hrī: gdod nas mngon rdzogs brdal khyab nam mkha'i dbyings: dus gsum 'gyur med thig le chen po'i klong: 'od gsal nyi ma 'bum brdal zhing khams na: rig pa rang byung gzhon nu bum pa'i sku: ma 'gag rang rtsal rigs brgya'i 'khor lo'i bdag: bla med bla ma bde chen phyag rgyar bzhengs: che ba'i che mchog gu ru thod phreng rtsal: 'dir so so'i mtshan bsgyur/ thogs med zang thal zhing kun sku la rdzogs: 'khor 'das kun khyab gsung mchog gsang sngags mdzod: bsam yas ye shes dgongs pa phyogs lhung bral: yon tan 'gro ba'i re ba yid bzhin skong: lhun grub phrin las 'khor ba dong nas sprugs: byin rlabs sprin 'khrigs smin grol char rgyun 'beb:

rtsa gsum sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i 'khor dang bcas: dad mos gdung bas thugs dam rgyud bskul na: dbyings nas sku skyod skal ldan byin gyis rlobs: lus ngag yid la rdo rje'i dbang bzhi skur: sgrib bzhi'i bag chags byin rlabs chu bos bkrus: rtsa rlung thig le ye shes chen por smin: gnas skabs rig 'dzin rnam bzhi bde blag 'grub: mthar thug bde chen sku bzhi myur thob mdzod: snying pos thog drangs las sbyor sngags: ba liṃ ta dzñā na mu dra kā ya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ: wā ka a bhi ṣiñtsa ā: tsit+ta a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: sarba a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī: lha nyid 'od zhu bdud rtsi'i bcud: dngos grub gnyis thob bsams la rol: dbang bskur kun gyi grub mtha' ru: ngo sprod dgongs pa dbyings su bskyal: a: thog mtha' med pa chos kyi sku: rang byung rig pa'i gshis su rdzogs: de nyid bla ma phyag rgya che: blo 'das brjod med dbyings su zhog: don dam bla ma kun tu bzang: rig pa 'od gsal 'di kho na: ma btsal gdod nas lhun gyis grub: don rtogs dbang chen brnyes pa 'o: a a a: zhes brjod ngo sprod thebs par gdab: shis pa brjod la rjes rim bya: sa ma ya: rdzogs smin sbyang ba sngon song ba'i: blo chen zab mo'i snod rung la: gong ma'i dbang gsum sbyin 'dod na: bum dbang sku yi byin rlabs kyis: tha mal snang zhen lhar rtogs nas: bla ma yab yum mnyam sbyor ba'i: byang sems bdud rtsi lce la bzhag: āḥ thabs shes mnyam par sbyor ba'i bcud: dkar dmar lhag pa'i byang sems kyis: rtsa rlung thig ler byin brlabs pas: gsang ba'i lam mchog mthar phyin shog: bo dhi tsit+ta gu h+ya a bhi ṣiñtsa ā:1$0000250 bdag byin brlab pa'i rim pa yis: rang lus thabs ldan brtan thob bya: 1$0000300mtshan ldan rig ma lag tu sbyin: man ngag ldan pas sbyor gzhug la: ho: rgyal kun dam tshig bla na med: rdo rje rig ma'i brtul zhugs kyis:

nye rgyu'i spyod pa mthar phyin nas: sa lam gcig chod bgrod gyur cig: karma mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐:1$0000250 lugs 'byung lugs ldog dga' bzhi spel: lhan skyes ye shes ngos zin bya: 1$0000300mtshon byed dpe las skyes pa'i don: mtshon bya tshig gis ngo sprad pa: a ho: smra med bde ba'i ngo bo nyid: rang byung chos sku de kho na: dgag sgrub bral ba'i ngang du zhog: skad cig mngon par byang chub bo: a a a: gnas lugs thabs kyis rtogs pa'i tshe: rig pa rtsal gyi dbang bskur sbyin: hrī: ngo bo ka dag chos kyi sku: rang bzhin 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs: ma 'gag rtsal shar sprul pa'i sku: dbyer med dgongs pa'i gding thob shog: dharma dhā tu dzñā na a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐: 1$0000250mnyam gzhag khregs chod brtan thob nas: lhun grub thod rgal lam du khyer: 1$0000300 gong ma'i zab dbang gsum kar yang: so so'i mtha' rten byin rlabs sbrel: tha mal sgo gsum sgrib gnyis sbyong: rgyud smin sku bzhi'i sa bon thebs: bskyed rdzogs rdzogs pa chen po'i lam: bsgom rung zab mo'i smin byed do: sa ma ya: rigs 'dzin rgyud lung kun gyi bcud: ye shes chen po'i spyi dbang 'dir: gang 'brel gu rus rjes su 'dzin: gnas skabs 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub: mthar thug bla ma'i sa la sbyor: nor 'dod rin chen gling phyin bzhin: bsam rgu 'grub pa'i smin byed do: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: :
